Text: Grok 4.6 just made Opus look expensive!

We ran a real-world benchmark: Grok 4.6 and Claude Opus 5 one-shotted three 3D scenes of @elonmusk 's TERAFAB megafactory in three.js - the exterior at dusk, the cleanroom fab floor, and the central operations hall with walking workers. No edits, straight from the API.

Both delivered working code on the first try. But the economics aren't close:

Grok 4.6 - $0.38
Claude Opus 5 - $2.06

That's 5.4x cheaper for comparable output - and Grok also spent noticeably fewer tokens per scene. At demo scale that's pennies, at production volume it's the difference in your monthly bill!
